baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional chain runs from asking, through exhaustive pressure, to withholding and the bringing-out of the plural possessive adghan.
baseline_models.mechanism: A request becomes diagnostic when insistence reaches the hearers' attachment threshold. Withholding is the first observable response, while the final causative exit verb makes concealed antagonism the deeper output of the same pressure.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the initiating demand in the conditional chain.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the pressure that turns a request into a test.
Wrongful holding-back supplies the visible resistance produced by the pressure.
Extraction from concealment supplies the final disclosure of what withholding had kept inward.

changed_reading.before: An unusually large request would simply make the addressees stingy and angry.
changed_reading.after: The hypothetical demand is a diagnostic pressure sequence: stinginess is its visible reading, while concealed antagonism is what the sequence is designed to surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine object pronoun marks something requested, and the sequence opposes keeping possessions to an involuntary outward production of adghan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The requested object is construed as an account payable. When pressing is experienced as deprivation, the addressees defend their holdings; the intended material outflow is blocked, but an affective claim against the demander is externalized instead.

activation_trace.role: The requested need or object gives the pronoun an account-like object of claim.
Deprivation and denial supplies the addressees' possible construal of being pressed.
Withholding possessions functions as resistance to the perceived debit.
Money going out on a known charge supplies the fiscal register behind the blocked transfer.
Bringing a hidden thing out redirects the failed material payment into disclosed grievance.

changed_reading.before: Stinginess is an isolated defect exposed by a demand for property.
changed_reading.after: Stinginess and rancor form a contested-account response: a demand felt as uncompensated deprivation blocks material outflow and voices an inward grievance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same h-f-w inventory holds both solicitous care and exhausting insistence, directly before withholding and disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: A request ordinarily sits inside expectations of need-fulfillment and attentive regard. Excessive insistence crosses that relational threshold, so holding back registers not only attachment to property but a perceived breach of reciprocity that releases old resentment.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilling a request supplies the reciprocal expectation latent around asking.
Attentive care and honor supplies the positive relational pole of h-f-w.
Exhausting insistence supplies the inversion from regard into felt exploitation.
Withholding becomes a relational refusal once the reciprocity threshold is crossed.
Extraction from hiding makes prior resentment the residue exposed by the rupture.

changed_reading.before: The verse imagines one-sided exaction followed by predictable refusal.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage a reciprocity threshold: attentive relationship is perceived as overreaching insistence, and refusal reveals grievances already stored inside that relationship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence turns the focus conditional into one concrete disclosure procedure. Concealed antagonism is first said to be brought out, then becomes recognizable through marks and verbal inflection, and finally sits inside a test that makes inward reports knowable; pressure over giving supplies the behavioral probe.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive insistence functions as the probe applied in the focus conditional.
Withholding supplies the observable response to that probe.
Extraction from concealment supplies the inferred interior result.
The earlier bringing-out of hidden matter establishes disclosure as an explicit local concern.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies the transition from latent state to readable evidence.
A visible mark indicating condition supplies one channel by which the concealed state becomes legible.
Speech inclining toward its implication supplies a subtler channel of involuntary disclosure.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the encompassing experimental frame.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior supplies the test's hidden object.

structural_cues: 47:29 repeats the خ ر ج plus adghan construction before 47:37; ض غ ن has no packet branch inventory and is used only as this structural repetition.
47:30 moves from visible marks to tonal implication, and 47:31 follows with testing and reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated extraction, readable signs, tonal implication, testing, and inward report; I infer a probe-to-behavior-to-disclosure arrow. A live alternative is that 47:29-31 concerns a narrower diseased-heart group while 47:37 warns the whole addressed community.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a local emotional reaction to an excessive monetary request.
changed_reading.after: It occupies a larger revelation protocol: resource pressure elicits withholding, withholding becomes evidence, and evidence externalizes an otherwise hidden allegiance-state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus no longer reads as a report of divine fiscal need. It is bracketed by reward and an explicit denial of asking for the audience's wealth, then by a call to spend and the rich/poor asymmetry; the exhaustive demand is therefore a limiting counterfactual that measures attachment rather than a revenue policy.

activation_trace.role: The focus request supplies the hypothetical action whose purpose is being revised.
Exhaustive insistence marks the imagined demand as a limiting case rather than an ordinary call.
Compensation for work supplies a preceding direction of value toward the addressees.
The immediately preceding negated request fixes the contrast for the focus conditional.
Possessing and accumulating wealth supplies the explicit antecedent domain for the focus pronoun.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the actual requested practice after the counterfactual.
Repeated withholding confirms attachment as the tested human response rather than divine need.
Self-sufficiency removes lack on the divine side of the transaction.
Human need and scant means locate dependency on the side being asked.

structural_cues: 47:36 denies asking for the audience's wealth, 47:37 resumes with the feminine object pronoun, and 47:38 names expenditure.
The conditional particle and plural second-person forms hold the excessive-demand scenario at communal hypothetical distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reward, a negated wealth-request, actual expenditure, and the rich/poor polarity; I infer that exhaustive asking is a counterfactual upper bound used to expose attachment. The alternative is that the conditional still warns about a possible severe actual demand.

changed_reading.before: The verse imagines a demander needing to take nearly everything from the community.
changed_reading.after: The demander is explicitly non-needy; the maximal request is an unrealized stress test that distinguishes legitimate expenditure from the total loss the possessive self fears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two ayat create rival outlets. Voluntary expenditure is the proper passage by which wealth leaves; withholding blocks that passage, but the focus exit verb reroutes outward movement so that concealed affect emerges instead. The following reflexive formulation makes the blockage recoil on the withholder's own self.

activation_trace.role: Withholding closes the voluntary material outlet in the focus chain.
Movement from an interior to an exterior supplies the involuntary alternative outlet.
Extraction from concealment identifies hidden affect as what passes through that outlet.
The departure of money in expenditure supplies the voluntary outflow blocked by stinginess.
A penetrating passage with an exit supplies the conduit image joining expenditure to emergence.
Triple repetition intensifies withholding as the blockage around which the reversal turns.
The thing's own self supplies the reflexive endpoint on which blocked generosity recoils.

structural_cues: 47:37 places refused material movement beside involuntary inward-to-outward movement.
47:38 repeats b-kh-l three times and explicitly directs its effect against the withholder's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies monetary outflow, a passage-with-exit image, the focus exit verb, and reflexive self-direction; I infer a blocked-outlet rerouting from wealth to affect. A live alternative is ordinary moral consequence with no conduit analogy.

changed_reading.before: Refusal keeps wealth inside and separately causes resentment to become known.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can behave like a two-outlet system: when voluntary wealth-outflow is blocked, involuntary affective outflow exposes the self that tried to retain it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imagined exaction is surrounded by warnings not to void one's own work and assurances that work will not be diminished and will receive compensation. The exposed adghan can therefore be read as an accounting grievance: pressure reveals whether contribution is misperceived as uncompensated loss despite the surrounding guarantee.

activation_trace.role: Deprivation supplies the feared reading of what exhaustive pressure would do.
Withholding supplies the defensive response to the feared uncompensated loss.
Removing or nullifying something supplies the nearby warning that agents can erase their own work.
Intentional work supplies the value that the audience is warned not to invalidate.
A loss that deprives one of a right or work supplies the expressly negated deficit.
The wage or provision of work supplies the compensated value protected from diminution.
Reward for labor supplies the positive settlement promised immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 47:33, 47:35, and 47:36 form a sequence of work not to be voided, work not to be deprived, and reward to be given before 47:37.
Possessive plurals repeatedly bind deeds, rewards, wealth, and adghan to the same addressed group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-nullification, negated deprivation, and promised compensation; I infer that pressure exposes a zero-sum account in which contribution feels like stolen credit. The alternative is that adghan names broader hostility unrelated to any compensation calculus.

changed_reading.before: Material attachment alone explains the withholding and rancor.
changed_reading.after: A perceived accounting injustice can mediate them: the addressee treats contribution as uncompensated subtraction even while the context promises preservation and reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disclosure is not merely punitive exposure. Testing makes noncooperation visible; the focus demand supplies a resource-stress case; and the following turn-away and replacement sequence gives that evidence a communal consequence. Private attachment becomes a criterion by which one collective can cease to carry a role and another stand in its place.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes condition appear supplies the sorting frame preceding the focus.
Withholding supplies the concrete failure of cooperation made visible under stress.
Bringing hidden matter out makes the failure available for communal consequence.
Turning away supplies the overt withdrawal that follows latent withholding.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the consequence of failed participation.
A collective of people supplies the social unit subject to replacement.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from testing in 47:31 to plural resource pressure in 47:37 and plural replacement in 47:38.
The focus's plural verbs and plural possessive make the disclosure communal even though withholding is behaviorally individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, exposed withholding, turning away, substitution, and a people; I infer that disclosure functions as a selection signal linking inner resistance to role replacement. The alternative is that replacement responds only to general apostasy, not specifically to the focus pressure-test.

changed_reading.before: The verse exposes a private vice and hidden private feeling.
changed_reading.after: It can also mark a communal sorting threshold: resource pressure reveals nonparticipation that can culminate in the collective being replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context links turning away to severed kinship, closed hearts, and concealed commitments. Against that sequence, withholding under communal demand is not merely parsimonious behavior; it is the resource-level manifestation of a bond already fractured inwardly, and the focus exit verb makes that fracture public.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the relational withdrawal that precedes overt severance.
Cutting connection supplies the social effect of inward withdrawal.
Kinship supplies the concrete bond vulnerable to that severance.
The heart supplies the interior location in which relational resistance persists.
Closure and hardening supplies the blocked interior condition before disclosure.
Keeping something hidden inwardly supplies the concealment phase of divided allegiance.
Withholding turns the concealed relational break into observable noncooperation.
Extraction from hiddenness supplies the public emergence of the prior fracture.

structural_cues: 47:22-26 progresses from turning away and cutting bonds to closed hearts and concealed commitments.
The plural possessive on adghan lets the focus collect private interior breaks into a shared social problem without supplying a branch inventory for ض غ ن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, severed kinship, heart-closure, secrecy, withholding, and extraction; I infer that contribution pressure reveals an already weakened bond. The alternative is that the earlier relational rupture and the later monetary hypothetical address separate mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns individual miserliness under financial pressure.
changed_reading.after: Financial withholding becomes the point where concealed relational rupture enters public behavior: the unshared resource discloses an already unshared allegiance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because barefoot abrasion, close shaving, and a bodily sore are material branch images rather than the ordinary lexical rendering of the clause. It remains anchored in the consecutive focus verbs and preserves their pressure-to-emergence order; downstream prose should present it only as a tactile analogy for diagnostic pressure, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The h-f-w verb immediately precedes withholding, and the causative kh-r-j verb immediately governs the final hidden-affect object.

activation_trace.role: A foot or hoof worn thin by repeated travel supplies cumulative abrasion under pressure.
Shaving down to the limit supplies removal of the protective margin around possession and affect.
A sore emerging on the body supplies the image of concealed injury breaking the social surface.
Withholding supplies the contraction that appears before the inward wound surfaces.

changed_reading.before: Pressure merely causes a hidden grievance to be stated or detected.
changed_reading.after: Pressure can be pictured as abrasion that strips a protective layer until withheld attachment contracts and concealed injury erupts at the surface.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's split s-l-l mapping beneath the focus's asking form and combines it with the hand-revelation game branch of kh-r-j. It remains worth carrying because both citations attach to exact focus words and sharpen the staged disclosure sequence; downstream prose should mark it as branch-induced wordplay, never as the base morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening focus verb has a packet-supplied split mapping to concealed drawing-out, while the later exit verb can image a game that reveals what a hand contains.

activation_trace.role: Gentle concealed withdrawal supplies a form-distant image of drawing attachment out incrementally.
Stealthy taking supplies the suspicious construal under which a request feels like hidden removal.
Insistent pursuit supplies the repeated move that forces the concealed holding to declare itself.
Withholding supplies the clenched retention exposed by the staged request.
A game of making what is in the hand come out supplies the final reveal structure.

changed_reading.before: A direct request is followed by a direct refusal and disclosure.
changed_reading.after: The focus can carry an exploratory reveal-game image: incremental drawing tests the closed hand, and what finally comes out is not the retained property but the resentment organizing its retention.

strongest_changes: 47:29-31 turns the focus from an isolated reaction into a probe-to-sign-to-interior disclosure protocol.
47:36 and 47:38 make exhaustive asking a counterfactual test by bracketing it with divine reward, non-request, self-sufficiency, and human need.
The n-f-q passage image and repeated reflexive withholding support a live two-outlet reading in which blocked material outflow becomes involuntary affective outflow.
Protected deeds, promised compensation, and possible communal replacement keep accounting and social-sorting readings alive beside the diagnostic reading.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses request, pressure, refusal, and disclosure into one conditional chain. Context does not collapse that chain to a single moral; it simultaneously activates epistemic testing, contested accounting, relational rupture, self-directed blockage, and communal succession, while the material branches preserve stranger abrasion and reveal-game analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise scope of the feminine object pronoun remains open between wealth as a whole, an imagined exhaustive share, and the contribution under discussion.
The final exit can be heard as direct divine disclosure or as the pressure sequence itself making antagonism emerge; the mechanism changes subtly with that agency.
47:29 may narrow the repeated adghan disclosure to diseased hearts, whereas 47:37 grammatically addresses the wider community.
The abrasion, concealed-withdrawal, conduit, and care/exaction readings are branch-driven analogies whose explanatory value exceeds their lexical certainty.
